fair_value_reason: P/E: NTM EPS about $14.5 (0.25 x ~$13.45 2027E + 0.75 x ~$14.9 2028E) x 17.5x = about $254. FCF: NTM FCF about $3.45B (consensus-weighted) less 5% for leases = $3.28B / 187M diluted = $17.5/share; at 6.5% that is $269, less $6.2/share for the preferred and warrants = about $263. A 60/40 blend gives about $257, which I trim to $255 to credit part of agent_3's 2028 FCF skepticism (missile capex ahead of contracts). This is essentially the $254.2 agent mean and $5 below my round-1 $260, since the agents' EPS paths settled a little under my round-1 $14.6 NTM.
supervisor_summary: The revised forecasts converged. Every agent took up the round-1 corrections (2027 FCF consensus $3.135B, $968M DoW preferred plus $186M warrants and missile leases deducted, the 17-17.5x peer-median multiple, the Q3 date unconfirmed and after-close possible). Fair values now span only $251-257 and P(>=236) spans 0.545-0.56. The remaining spreads are judgment calls on the 2028 haircut, so I leave the ladder at the forecaster mean (P(>=236) 0.553, median about $246), put fair value at $255 and the thesis break at $185, with low confidence. The next real information is the Q3 print (date still unannounced) and, above all, Mehta's first 2027 guide in January.
key_drivers: 2026 guide ($11.80-12.00 GAAP EPS, $3.0B FCF) was raised Jul 29 and reaffirmed at the Aug 17 CEO change. The Jan 2027 first guide under Mehta, against 2027 consensus of $13.54, is the biggest single event.

Valuation anchors: Sep-2027 NTM EPS about $14.5 at the ~17.25-17.5x peer median, and NTM FCF about $3.45B less ~5% for missile leases at a ~6.5% yield. Upside rests on EPS growth and FCF, not re-rating.
CSD board-component shortage (CFO, Sep 9): Q2 and Q3 flat, Q4-weighted ramp, no duration given. Q4 delivery is the test for the highest-margin segment.

Senior claims and the missile build: the $968M DoW preferred (7% accretion) and $186M warrants (about $6.2/share), plus $2.2B committed ahead of contracts and partly lease-financed. The IPO revisit in mid-2027 is not assured (QIPO deadline Dec 31, 2027).
Budget path: CR to Dec 11, midterms Nov 3, then FY27 appropriations and the reconciliation or munitions supplemental set the sector multiple.
